steps.label: Authorization Warrant
steps.caption: Director General issues search warrant upon recorded reasons.

steps.label: Premises Entry
steps.caption: Search team enters residential and commercial properties.

steps.label: Inventory Taking
steps.caption: Officers catalog commercial stock without physical seizure.

steps.label: Asset Restraint
steps.caption: Restraint orders preserve bulky assets for limited period.

steps.label: Business Hours
steps.caption: Survey entry is restricted exclusively to business operating hours.

steps.label: Book Impounding
steps.caption: Books may be impounded for fifteen days without higher approval.

steps.label: Statement Recording
steps.caption: Officers record statements without administering formal oath.

steps.label: Retraction Rights
steps.caption: Uncorroborated confessions are deleted per Supreme Court ruling.

steps.label: Possession Presumption
steps.caption: Books and valuable assets found are presumed to belong to owner.

steps.label: Truth of Contents
steps.caption: Documentary contents and handwriting are presumed genuine.

steps.label: Cash Credit Test
steps.caption: Assessee substantiates identity, creditworthiness, and genuineness.

steps.label: Source of Source
steps.caption: Closely held entities prove ultimate source of investor capital.

steps.label: Base Tax Levy
steps.caption: Unexplained income attracts sixty percent statutory base tax.

steps.label: Surcharge Addition
steps.caption: Mandatory twenty five percent surcharge elevates tax burden.

steps.label: Loss Bar Rule
steps.caption: Statute strictly bars set off of business or capital losses.

steps.label: Foreign Treble Penalty
steps.caption: Undisclosed foreign assets face ninety percent treble penalty.

steps.label: Item Cataloging
steps.caption: Engine classifies discovered assets into inventory and cash.

steps.label: Seizure Legality
steps.caption: System flags illegal seizures of commercial stock in trade.

steps.label: Evidentiary Audit
steps.caption: Algorithm filters out uncorroborated survey admissions.

steps.label: Confiscation Summary
steps.caption: Engine calculates effective seventy eight percent tax liability.
